officialSources.observation: Official Municipal Committee Daska services-map index publishes the city map set.
Official 2023-24 Basemap-Daska City PDF; extracted legend includes Road Boundary, Parcel Boundary, and MC boundary layers. It is a rendered map document, not an exposed vector parcel API.
Official Sialkot district page identifies Revenue Department Daska and its land-record/revenue-administration context.
Official/public Punjab PULSE viewer advertises cadastral maps and parcel visualization with an indicative-boundary disclaimer; the page configuration points to Punjab_Cdastral_Maps.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describing GIS-linked land-record services.

This establishes local registry/map context, not legal title coverage or complete citywide vector coverage.

remainingUncertainty: The municipal PDF is rendered and its parcel lines may be generalized; it does not prove current legal or complete citywide parcel coverage. PULSE advertises cadastral mapping but anonymous ArcGIS access was token-gated, so no parcel schema, CRS, native ID, or polygon was verified. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, or account fields were requested or retained.
